kaikki_vikisozluk.e: جُلَّنْجُبِين or جُلَّنْجَبِين or جُلَنْجُبِين or جُلَنْجَبِين • (jullanjubīn or jullanjabīn or julanjubīn or julanjabīn) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Persian گلانگبین (gol-angobin, gol-angabin, literally “rose-honey”), from گل (gol, “rose”) + انگبین (angobin, angabin, “honey”).
g: a conserve or drink of rose petals in honey
